532:t_2:220.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're talkative today. Or are you hiding your embarrassment over failing your mission?」

532:t_2:221.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「As I thought, being with you disturbs me.」

532:t_2:222.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you're trying to erase me...?! Some void you have!」

532:t_2:224.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Unfortunately for you, dying to dodge my debts isn't my style!」

532:t_2:225.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Is that strong will your power?」

532:t_2:226.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm embarrassed to say it is.」

532:t_2:227.en:
$n
「$$クロウ$$! I'm coming over right now!!」

532:t_2:231.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You are correct. Your existence gets in the way of my being myself.」

532:t_2:232.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「But for now, I will pursue him.」

532:t_2:237.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yes... In the flesh, that bastard is even more like a bottomless pit than when he's in his machine.」

532:t_2:238.en:
$n
「His men are closing in on $$神根島$$. Let's hurry.」

532:t_2:240.en:
$$クロウ$$
(It seems he's carrying some burden of his own...)

532:t_3:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

532:t_3:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Tell us, $$ゼロ$$. What did you see in those ruins?」

532:t_3:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I was no different from everyone else.」

532:t_3:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$集合無意識$$ showed us our individual images of a future of despair.」

532:t_3:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They took various forms: visions of the future, warnings from someone, or invitations.」

532:t_3:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Could that be the true nature of the unease $n and I feel?」

532:t_3:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes... It is also the future described by those who touched the $$黒の英知$$ and Colonel $$シャア$$, who became a $$特異点$$.」

532:t_3:11.en:
$$レド$$
「Despair awaits us on the path ahead...」

532:t_3:15.en:
$$ランカ$$
「We can't change it... It's fate...」

532:t_3:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Will you give up because it is predetermined?」

532:t_3:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I will struggle until the very last moment...!」

532:t_3:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I refuse to accept any predetermined fate...! I will overturn it...! That is the miracle I will create!」

532:t_3:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What about all of you? Will you give up here because you can't win anyway?」

532:t_3:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「It is foolish to worry about winning or losing a battle you haven't fought.」

532:t_3:24.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's right. A soldier thinks of ways to win instead of lamenting a losing battle.」

532:t_3:25.en:
$$アルト$$
「The moment you fall into despair is when you truly lose.」

532:t_3:26.en:
$$レド$$
「There are things we must do before giving up.」

532:t_3:27.en:
$$桂$$
「So let's do it. Let's challenge that future of despair.」

532:t_3:28.en:
$n
「We fight to overcome it. That was true before, and it will remain true.」

532:t_3:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It seems asking was tactless of me.」

532:t_3:30.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We aren't naive enough to fall for your scare tactics.」

532:t_3:31.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「But what will we do...? In the end, the information we gained never went beyond images.」

532:t_3:32.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「There is the being who engraved the $$烙印$$ on us... And there is the one who brings the future of despair...」

532:t_3:33.en:
$n
「Is it connected to the fundamental calamity we saw in that universe after all...?」

532:t_3:36.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You seem to have sensed something in those ruins.」

532:t_3:38.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I know the being that calls itself God.」

532:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is unusual. $$キリコ$$ spoke up of his own accord.」

532:t_10:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's how serious our situation is.」

532:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And why have you come all the way to see me, $$ゼロ$$?」

532:t_10:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Apparently, even $$モーム$$, a robot, glimpsed a future of despair in the $$集合無意識$$.」

532:t_10:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... You come from a different world than ours. I wanted to see what you would see there.」

532:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「P-Please spare me! I absolutely want no part of any future of despair!」

532:t_10:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That is the answer I expected. I knew expecting anything from you was a mistake.」

532:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, exactly! You are as wise as ever, $$ゼロ$$!」

532:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that we've finished talking, let me ask one thing! Let's give it our all today...!」

532:t_10:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll refuse today. If you had gone to the ruins with us, I might have played along.」

532:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I'll call it good enough. You've already said it once, $$ゼロ$$.」

532:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Besides, I grew sick of futures of despair long ago.)

533:t_000:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What's the situation around us?」

533:t_000:1.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I cannot confirm any readings that appear to be enemies.」

533:t_000:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「But Imperial troops should have been stationed throughout this area of $$神根島$$.」

533:t_000:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「There are signs of combat...」

533:t_000:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Someone must have eliminated the Imperial troops guarding this island.」

533:t_000:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Time is precious. I'll land immediately.」
